question: Which epithets of seniority and eminence are attributed to the lord of cowherds in this salutation?
premises: The deity is addressed as eldest.
The deity is addressed as preeminent.
The deity is addressed as lord of cowherds and receives repeated obeisance.
inference: The mantra offers repeated obeisance to the eldest, preeminent lord of cowherds.
uncertainties: The precise sense of proṣṭhāya is uncertain
plain_english: Obeisance to the eldest, the preeminent, the lord of cowherds; obeisance, obeisance.
